Now, let's create a context for managing our feeding data:



---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
+ 
+ interface FeedingEntry {
+   date: string;
+   amountFed: number;
+   target: number;
+   timestamp: number;
+ }
+ 
+ interface FeedingContextType {
+   currentFeeding: FeedingEntry | null;
+   history: FeedingEntry[];
+   loading: boolean;
+   error: string | null;
+   updateFeeding: (amount: number) => Promise<void>;
+   loadHistory: () => Promise<void>;
+ }
+ 
+ const FeedingContext = createContext<FeedingContextType | undefined>(undefined);
+ 
+ export const FeedingProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
+   const [currentFeeding, setCurrentFeeding] = useState<FeedingEntry | null>(null);
+   const [history, setHistory] = useState<FeedingEntry[]>([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+ 
+   const loadTodayData = async () => {
+     try {
+       const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+       const jsonValue = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay');
+       let data = jsonValue != null ? JSON.parse(jsonValue) : null;
+ 
+       if (!data || data.date !== today) {
+         const settings = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:settings');
+         const parsedSettings = settings ? JSON.parse(settings) : { target: 3 };
+ 
+         data = {
+           date: today,
+           amountFed: 0,
+           target: parsedSettings.target,
+           timestamp: Date.now(),
+         };
+ 
+         await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay', JSON.stringify(data));
+       }
+ 
+       setCurrentFeeding(data);
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError('Error loading today\'s data');
+       console.error(e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const loadHistory = async () => {
+     try {
+       const historyJson = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory');
+       const historyData = historyJson ? JSON.parse(historyJson) : [];
+       setHistory(historyData);
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError('Error loading history');
+       console.error(e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const updateFeeding = async (amount: number) => {
+     try {
+       if (!currentFeeding) return;
+ 
+       const updatedFeeding = {
+         ...currentFeeding,
+         amountFed: amount,
+         timestamp: Date.now(),
+       };
+ 
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:currentDay', JSON.stringify(updatedFeeding));
+       setCurrentFeeding(updatedFeeding);
+ 
+       // Update history
+       const historyJson = await AsyncStorage.getItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory');
+       const historyData = historyJson ? JSON.parse(historyJson) : [];
+       
+       const existingIndex = historyData.findIndex((item: FeedingEntry) => item.date === updatedFeeding.date);
+       if (existingIndex >= 0) {
+         historyData[existingIndex] = updatedFeeding;
+       } else {
+         historyData.push(updatedFeeding);
+       }
+ 
+       await AsyncStorage.setItem('@PoppyTracker:feedingHistory', JSON.stringify(historyData));
+       setHistory(historyData);
+     } catch (e) {
+       setError('Error updating feeding data');
+       console.error(e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const initializeData = async () => {
+       setLoading(true);
+       await Promise.all([loadTodayData(), loadHistory()]);
+       setLoading(false);
+     };
+ 
+     initializeData();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   return (
+     <FeedingContext.Provider
+       value={{
+         currentFeeding,
+         history,
+         loading,
+         error,
+         updateFeeding,
+         loadHistory,
+       }}
+     >
+       {children}
+     </FeedingContext.Provider>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export const useFeeding = () => {
+   const context = useContext(FeedingContext);
+   if (context === undefined) {
+     throw new Error('useFeeding must be used within a FeedingProvider');
+   }
+   return context;
+ }; 
```

+ import React from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
+ import { COLORS, BORDER_RADIUS } from '../constants/Theme';
+ 
+ interface CupIconProps {
+   fillPercentage: number;
+   isComplete?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export const CupIcon: React.FC<CupIconProps> = ({ fillPercentage, isComplete = false }) => {
+   return (
+     <View style={styles.container}>
+       <View style={styles.cup}>
+         <View
+           style={[
+             styles.fill,
+             {
+               height: `${fillPercentage}%`,
+               backgroundColor: isComplete ? COLORS.accent : COLORS.primary,
+             },
+           ]}
+         />
+       </View>
+     </View>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     width: 40,
+     height: 60,
+     marginHorizontal: 8,
+   },

+     width: '100%',
+     height: '100%',
+     backgroundColor: COLORS.background,
+     borderWidth: 2,
+     borderColor: COLORS.primary,
+     borderRadius: BORDER_RADIUS.md,
+     overflow: 'hidden',
+   },
+   fill: {
+     width: '100%',
+     position: 'absolute',
+     bottom: 0,
+     borderBottomLeftRadius: BORDER_RADIUS.md,
+     borderBottomRightRadius: BORDER_RADIUS.md,
+   },
+ });

Now let's create the FeedingProgress component that will display a row of cup icons:




---

```diff
- 
+ import React from 'react';
+ import { View, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
+ import { CupIcon } from './CupIcon';
+ import { SPACING } from '../constants/Theme';
+ 
+ interface FeedingProgressProps {
+   amountFed: number;
+   targetAmount: number;
+ }
+ 
+ export const FeedingProgress: React.FC<FeedingProgressProps> = ({
+   amountFed,
+   targetAmount,
+ }) => {
+   const cups = [];
+   const totalCups = Math.ceil(targetAmount);
+ 
+   for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
+     let fillPercentage = 0;
+     if (amountFed > i) {
+       fillPercentage = amountFed >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amountFed - i) * 100;
+     }
+ 
+     cups.push(
+       <CupIcon
+         key={i}
+         fillPercentage={fillPercentage}
+         isComplete={fillPercentage === 100}
+       />
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return <View style={styles.container}>{cups}</View>;
+ };
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     paddingVertical: SPACING.md,
+   },
+ }); 
```

Now let's create the Home screen that will display the feeding tracker:




---

```diff
- 
+ import React, { useState } from 'react';
+ import {
+   View,
+   Text,
+   StyleSheet,
+   TouchableOpacity,
+   SafeAreaView,
+ } from 'react-native';
+ import { useFeeding } from '../context/FeedingContext';
+ import { FeedingProgress } from '../components/FeedingProgress';
+ import { COLORS, TYPOGRAPHY, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS } from '../constants/Theme';
+ 
+ export default function HomeScreen() {
+   const { currentFeeding, updateFeeding } = useFeeding();
+   const [amount, setAmount] = useState(currentFeeding?.amountFed || 0);
+ 
+   const handleIncrement = () => {
+     const newAmount = Math.min(amount + 0.25, currentFeeding?.target || 3);
+     setAmount(newAmount);
+     updateFeeding(newAmount);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleDecrement = () => {
+     const newAmount = Math.max(amount - 0.25, 0);
+     setAmount(newAmount);
+     updateFeeding(newAmount);
+   };
+ 
+   if (!currentFeeding) {
+     return (
+       <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
+         <Text>Loading...</Text>
+       </SafeAreaView>
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
+       <View style={styles.header}>
+         <Text style={styles.title}>Poppy's Food Tracker</Text>
+       </View>
+ 
+       <View style={styles.content}>
+         <Text style={styles.subtitle}>Today's Feeding</Text>
+         
+         <FeedingProgress
+           amountFed={amount}
+           targetAmount={currentFeeding.target}
+         />
+ 
+         <View style={styles.controls}>
+           <TouchableOpacity
+             style={[styles.button, styles.decrementButton]}
+             onPress={handleDecrement}
+           >
+             <Text style={styles.buttonText}>-</Text>
+           </TouchableOpacity>
+ 
+           <View style={styles.amountDisplay}>
+             <Text style={styles.amountText}>{amount.toFixed(2)}</Text>
+             <Text style={styles.unitText}>cups</Text>
+           </View>
+ 
+           <TouchableOpacity
+             style={[styles.button, styles.incrementButton]}
+             onPress={handleIncrement}
+           >
+             <Text style={styles.buttonText}>+</Text>
+           </TouchableOpacity>
+         </View>
+ 
+         <View style={styles.summary}>
+           <Text style={styles.summaryText}>
+             Target: {currentFeeding.target} cups
+           </Text>
+           <Text style={styles.summaryText}>
+             Remaining: {(currentFeeding.target - amount).toFixed(2)} cups
+           </Text>
+         </View>
+       </View>
+     </SafeAreaView>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     backgroundColor: COLORS.background,
+   },
+   header: {
+     padding: SPACING.md,
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   title: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.title,
+     color: COLORS.text,
+   },
+   content: {
+     flex: 1,
+     padding: SPACING.md,
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   subtitle: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.subtitle,
+     color: COLORS.text,
+     marginBottom: SPACING.md,
+   },
+   controls: {
+     flexDirection: 'row',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+     marginVertical: SPACING.lg,
+   },
+   button: {
+     width: 60,
+     height: 60,
+     borderRadius: BORDER_RADIUS.lg,
+     justifyContent: 'center',
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   decrementButton: {
+     backgroundColor: COLORS.secondary,
+   },
+   incrementButton: {
+     backgroundColor: COLORS.accent,
+   },
+   buttonText: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.title,
+     color: COLORS.white,
+   },
+   amountDisplay: {
+     marginHorizontal: SPACING.xl,
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   amountText: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.title,
+     color: COLORS.text,
+   },
+   unitText: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.body,
+     color: COLORS.text,
+   },
+   summary: {
+     marginTop: SPACING.xl,
+     alignItems: 'center',
+   },
+   summaryText: {
+     ...TYPOGRAPHY.body,
+     color: COLORS.text,
+     marginVertical: SPACING.xs,
+   },
+ }); 
```

+ import React from 'react';
+ import {
+   View,
+   Text,
+   StyleSheet,
+   FlatList,
+   SafeAreaView,
+ } from 'react-native';
+ import { useFeeding } from '../context/FeedingContext';
+ import { FeedingProgress } from '../components/FeedingProgress';
+ import { COLORS, TYPOGRAPHY, SPACING, BORDER_RADIUS } from '../constants/Theme';
+ 
+ export default function HistoryScreen() {
+   const { history } = useFeeding();
+ 
+   const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: any }) => (
+     <View style={styles.historyItem}>
+       <Text style={styles.dateText}>
+         {new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString()}
+       </Text>
+       <FeedingProgress
+         amountFed={item.amountFed}
+         targetAmount={item.target}
+       />
+       <Text style={styles.amountText}>
+         {item.amountFed.toFixed(2)} / {item.target} cups
+       </Text>
+     </View>
+   );
+ 
+   return (
+     <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
+       <View style={styles.header}>
+         <Text style={styles.title}>Feeding History</Text>
+       </View>
+ 
+       <FlatList
+         data={history}
+         renderItem={renderItem}
+         keyExtractor={(item) => item.date}
+         contentContainerStyle={styles.list}
+       />
+     </SafeAreaView>
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ const styles = StyleSheet.create({
+   container: {
+     flex: 1,
+     backgroundColor: COLORS.background,
+   },
+   header: {

- # Welcome to your Expo app 👋

- This is an [Expo](https://expo.dev) project created with [`create-expo-app`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-expo-app).

- 
+ # Poppy's Food Tracker
+ 
+ A React Native mobile app built with Expo for iOS that helps track how much dog food has been given to Poppy each day. The app features a simple, cute interface with a Poppy theme and stores feeding history in device storage.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - Daily Feeding Tracker: Record and adjust the amount of food (in cups) given to Poppy
+ - Visual Progress Indicator: Cup icons showing feeding progress
+ - History View: Access past feeding records
+ - Local Storage: Store feeding data on the device
+ - API Integration: Future capability to sync with backend
+ 
+ ## Getting Started
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ - Node.js (v18.18 or higher)
+ - npm or yarn
+ - Expo CLI
+ - iOS Simulator or physical iOS device
+ 
+ ### Installation
+ 
+ 1. Clone the repository
+ 2. Install dependencies:
     ```bash
     npm install
     ```
- 
- 2. Start the app
- 
+ 3. Start the development server:
     ```bash
-     npx expo start
+    npm start
     ```
- 
- In the output, you'll find options to open the app in a
- 
- - [development build](https://docs.expo.dev/develop/development-builds/introduction/)
- - [Android emulator](https://docs.expo.dev/workflow/android-studio-emulator/)
- - [iOS simulator](https://docs.expo.dev/workflow/ios-simulator/)
- - [Expo Go](https://expo.dev/go), a limited sandbox for trying out app development with Expo
- 
- You can start developing by editing the files inside the **app** directory. This project uses [file-based routing](https://docs.expo.dev/router/introduction).
- 
- ## Get a fresh project
- 
- When you're ready, run:
- 
- ```bash
- npm run reset-project
- ```
- 
- This command will move the starter code to the **app-example** directory and create a blank **app** directory where you can start developing.
- 
- ## Learn more
- 
- To learn more about developing your project with Expo, look at the following resources:
- 
- - [Expo documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/): Learn fundamentals, or go into advanced topics with our [guides](https://docs.expo.dev/guides).
- - [Learn Expo tutorial](https://docs.expo.dev/tutorial/introduction/): Follow a step-by-step tutorial where you'll create a project that runs on Android, iOS, and the web.
- 
- ## Join the community
- 
- Join our community of developers creating universal apps.
- 
- - [Expo on GitHub](https://github.com/expo/expo): View our open source platform and contribute.
- - [Discord community](https://chat.expo.dev): Chat with Expo users and ask questions.
+ 4. Press 'i' to open in iOS simulator or scan the QR code with your iOS device
+ 
+ ## Project Structure
+ 
+ - `app/` - Contains the main screens and navigation
+ - `components/` - Reusable UI components
+ - `constants/` - Theme and configuration constants
+ - `context/` - React Context for state management
+ - `assets/` - Images and other static assets
+ 
+ ## Development
+ 
+ The app is built using:
+ - React Native with Expo
+ - Expo Router for navigation
+ - AsyncStorage for local data persistence
+ - React Context API for state management
+ 
+ ## Future Enhancements
+ 
+ - Backend API integration
+ - Push notifications for feeding reminders
+ - Statistics and insights
+ - Customizable feeding schedules
+ - Multiple pet support
+

  ### Progress Visualization Component
  
- ```jsx
- const FeedingProgressIndicator = ({ amountFed, targetAmount }) => {
-   const cups = [];
-   const totalCups = Math.ceil(targetAmount);
- 
-   for (let i = 0; i < totalCups; i++) {
-     // Calculate fill percentage for this cup
-     let fillPercentage = 0;
-     if (amountFed > i) {
-       fillPercentage = amountFed >= i + 1 ? 100 : (amountFed - i) * 100;
-     }
- 
-     cups.push(
-       <CupIcon
-         key={i}
-         fillPercentage={fillPercentage}
-         isComplete={fillPercentage === 100}
-       />
-     );
-   }
- 
-   return <View style={styles.progressContainer}>{cups}</View>;
- };
- ```
